newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ford Germany to recall Galaxy minivans.
newsitem.headline: Ford Germany to recall Galaxy minivans.

text.p: Ford-Werke AG, the German unit of U.S. carmaker Ford Motor Co, said on Thursday it was recalling 8,000 of its Ford minivans across Europe to fix a problem with a child seatbelt system.
Ford said the recall affects the Galaxy model, which is built in Portugal in a joint venture with German carmaker Volkswagen AG.
VW said earlier on Thursday it was recalling 12,000 of its VW Sharan minivans for the repair needed to fix the five point seatbelt for a child's seat.
The vehicle, which was first produced in June 1995, is also sold as the SEAT Alhambra, VW said.

VW said the problem was uncovered by the carmakers and that there were no complaints from customers. The repairs will be made free of charge and that customers affected by the recall will be notified in the coming days.
